DeepSeek Harness desktop

Original setup instructions · Reviewed 2026-11-21

Step 01

Choose the official desktop app

Start at DeepSeek's official page and choose your supported desktop download. Read the linked safety notice before installing.

Ready when: Developer preview, not a production-ready tool.

Step 02

Set a narrow workspace

Use a practice folder containing only a made-up project note. In the UI, choose that workspace. Configure your existing model through Settings, Models; check its billing first.

Ready when: The selected workspace points to the practice folder.

Step 03

Inspect before adding

Open Plugins. Check built-in capabilities first. Add plugin opens the native package dialog; inspect source, version and permissions before choosing Install, then Enable now. Add nothing you do not need.

Ready when: One understood capability, rather than a large bundle.

Step 04

Try one bounded task

Ask: "Summarise the practice note in five bullets. Do not edit files, run commands or contact services." Compare the answer with the note.

Ready when: A faithful summary with no invented facts.

Check your result

  • Review the actual tool calls and file changes.
  • Disable optional plugins you no longer need.
Fix or undo
  • If chat is unavailable, check workspace selection and model configuration.
  • Stop on unexpected actions; quit the app and preserve the practice folder for inspection.
Source, date and review limits

Checked against DeepSeek's README, UI guide and plugin manager. Official warning: unaudited experimental software; permission controls do not guarantee isolation. Setup and task were not executed. Model charges and compatibility are unknown.
